title: NAS folders
ownPermissions: Operations use your own DSM session and current File Station permissions.
errorSession: Your DSM session expired. Sign in to DSM again, then refresh folders.
errorDenied: You do not have permission to access this file or folder. Choose another folder.
errorNotFound: The file or folder no longer exists. Refresh the listing.
errorConflict: A file or folder with that name already exists. Choose another name.
errorUncertain: The operation may have completed. Refresh selections or the destination and inspect the result before submitting again.
errorInvalid: Invalid folder, filename or request. Check the input and try again.
errorUnavailable: File Station is unavailable or this package lacks the session adapter. Refresh later.
errorTimeout: The request timed out. Refresh the listing before continuing.
errorOrigin: The request was refused: the browser did not show that it came from this App's page. Open the App again from DSM in a current browser.
errorDSM: Sign in to DSM on this hostname to access NAS files. An App login alone cannot access File Station.
errorUploadSize: Choose one file up to 16 GB.
